blocks.title: Introduction
blocks.content:
Let $m,n$ be positive integers and let $W_{m,n}$ be the complex reflection group of type $G(m,1,n)$ in Shephard--Todd's classification [@ST]. It is well-known that $W_{m,n}$ is isomorphic to the wreath product $(\mathbb{Z}/m\mathbb{Z})^{n}\rtimes \mathfrak{S}_{n}$, where $\mathfrak{S}_{n}$ is the symmetric group of degree $n$ (generated by the simple transpositions $s_i=(i,i+1)$ for $i=1,\ldots,n-1$).

MARKOV TRACES ON DEGENERATE CYCLOTOMIC HECKE ALGEBRAS
DEKE ZHAO
Dedicated to Professor Yingbo Zhang on the occasion of her 80th birthday
Abstract. Let Hn(u) be the degenerate cyclotomic Hecke algebra with parameter u = {u1, . . . , um}.
The paper aims to define and construct the (non-)normalized Markov traces on the sequence {Hn(u)}∞
n=1.
This allows us to provide the Brou´e–Malle–Michel symmetrizing trace on Hn(u) and show that the
Brundan–Kleshchev trace is a specialization of the non-normalized Markov traces on Hn(u).

blocks.title: Non-normalized Markov traces
blocks.content:
[]{#Sec:BK-trace label="Sec:BK-trace"} In this section we construct a $\mathbb{C}(\boldsymbol{u})$--linear function on $H_n(\boldsymbol{u})$ by using the standard bases and show it constitutes a non-normalized Markov trace, thereby proving Theorem [\[Them:Markov-BK\]](#Them:Markov-BK){reference-type="ref" reference="Them:Markov-BK"} from the introduction.

The following easy verified fact will be useful.

::: lemma
[]{#Lemm:J-s_n label="Lemm:J-s_n"} For integers $1 \leq k\leq m-1$ and $n \geq 1$, we have $$\begin{aligned}
J_{n+1}^k s_n &= s_n J_n^k + \sum_{i=0}^{k-1} J_{n+1}^{k-1-i} J_n^i.
\en

blocks.title: Specializations
blocks.content:
This section is devoted to investigating the specializations of (non-)normalized Markov traces. In particular, we obtain the Broué--Malle--Michel symmetrizing trace on $H_n(\boldsymbol{u})$ and show that the Brundan--Kleshchev trace on $H_n(\boldsymbol{u})$ is a specialization of the non-normalized Markov trace.
